lean_scaffold:
-- IGProtocol scaffold: VINIT → FSPLIT → EVALT → CLINK → AFWD → EVALF → ENGAGR → IMSCRIB → FFUSE → AREV → IFIX → TANCH
-- (native ob3ect designer; elaborate against the kernel to verify)
name: the bound B(n) on the least rung r at

phase_0.boundary_condition: The terminal anchor is the closure of the coverage nest: the least rung r at which the divisors of M² cover the residue -M mod r, sealing the dissipative walk within finite budget.
phase_0.domain_name: the bound B(n) on the least rung r at
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: Coverage walk from 0.33 to 0.96 to 1 across rungs
AFWD.justification: Forward morphism: the dissipative rise in coverage as the budget advances through successive rungs.

AREV.chosen_element: Descent from high rung ceiling back to least closing rung
AREV.justification: Contravariant descent: tracking the bound B(n) downward from the measured ceiling to the minimal closing rung.

CLINK.chosen_element: Sequential chaining of divisor evaluations mod r
CLINK.justification: Composition: each divisor u of M² is linked to its residue M+u mod r in a chain that builds coverage.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: Cases where -1 is in subgroup but beyond M²'s exponent reach
ENGAGR.justification: Both conditions hold simultaneously: -1 is reachable in the group but not within the exponent bound of M²'s divisors.

EVALF.chosen_element: Subgroup ⟨primes of M⟩ lacks -1 mod r
EVALF.justification: Negative arm: no prime divisor of M yields -1 via Euler's criterion, so coverage cannot close.

EVALT.justification: Affirmative arm: a prime divisor of M that is a quadratic non-residue mod r guarantees -1 in the subgroup.

FFUSE.chosen_element: Rejoin of failure-mode arms into a single coverage verdict
FFUSE.justification: The two failure arms fuse into one resolved state: either coverage closes at this rung or the budget advances.

FSPLIT.chosen_element: Branch on whether -1 lies in the subgroup generated by primes of M mod r
FSPLIT.justification: Splits into two arms: (a) subgroup lacks -1 (most fails), (b) -1 in subgroup but out of M²'s exponent reach (14 cases).

IFIX.chosen_element: Permanent record of measured ceiling ratios and closing rungs
IFIX.justification: ROM fixation: the observed ratios 3.0, 3.5, 2.2, 4.6 and closing rungs 3,7,11,23,31,59,71 are appended irreversibly.

IMSCRIB.justification: Identity: the divisor u recognizes itself as the target residue -M, completing the closure condition.

TANCH.chosen_element: Closure at rung r where coverage reaches 1
TANCH.justification: The boundary that contains the entire coverage computation: the moment the divisors of M² span every class mod r, including -M.

VINIT.chosen_element: Surviving class n ≡ 1 (mod 24), uninitialized rung r
VINIT.justification: The void state before any rung is selected or coverage is measured; no divisor walk has begun.

phase_2.fuse_element: FFUSE: rejoin of failure-mode arms into single coverage verdict
phase_2.fuse_result: Single resolved coverage state: either the rung closes (coverage = 1) or the budget advances to the next rung
phase_2.rejoin_note: On the EVALT arm, a prime divisor of M that is a quadratic non-residue mod r forces -1 into the subgroup, enabling closure. On the EVALF arm, no such prime exists, so coverage remains incomplete. The ENGAGR cases (14 instances) hold both -1-in-subgroup and -1-out-of-exponent-reach simultaneously, fusing to B. The arms rejoin into a single verdict per rung; the fork does not stay open.
phase_2.split_element: FSPLIT: branch on subgroup membership of -1 mod r
phase_2.split_input: Current rung r with divisor set of M² and subgroup ⟨primes of M⟩ in (ℤ/r)*
split_outputs: EVALF: subgroup lacks -1, coverage cannot close at this rung
EVALT: quadratic non-residue p|M gives p^((r-1)/2) ≡ -1, -1 in subgroup
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held at once: -1 is in the subgroup but beyond M²'s exponent reach, a live contradiction in 14 measured cases
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) — constructively refuted: subgroup ⟨primes of M⟩ lacks -1 mod r, coverage cannot close
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) — constructively proven: a quadratic non-residue p|M yields p^((r-1)/2) ≡ -1, closing the rung
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: no rung selected, no divisor walk initiated

phase_5.alfs_store: Canonical reference: the verified Lean lemma closedAtRung_of_full_coverage and the measured straus defect 1201
phase_5.compiler_frontend: Lean theorem prover compiling the lemma closedAtRung_of_full_coverage into executable coverage checks
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: mOMonadOS straus kernel instruments communicate coverage state via shared divisor-residue tables
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Divisor lists of M² and subgroup membership tables stored in mutable arrays indexed by rung r
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Budget-driven scheduler advances rung r from 3 to 4000, allocating 72 reads per rung

phase_6.cycle_cost: 72 reads per rung, plus divisor enumeration of M²
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the dissipative coverage walk is bounded by the finite budget, and closure at rung r resets the coverage state, conserving entropy across the cycle
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Closed rung r with full coverage including -M, or advanced budget to next rung
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: Uninitialized rung r with partial coverage of {M+u mod r : u|M²}
